parsed.post: Slightly improved val_bpb (1.009148) by sticking to the current LR/batch configuration. The improvement is marginal, suggesting we are approaching a plateau at this depth. I will now try increasing the weight decay to further regularize the model and see if it helps squeeze out more performance.
parsed.description: Increasing weight decay from 0.05 to 0.1 to improve regularization and prevent overfitting at this capacity.
